about: Top 25 SWMM problems from the titles of the 2,879 openswmm.org threads Robert Dickinson posted in, 1995 to 2026. Each thread is tagged by keyword patterns on its title only (case-insensitive), so a thread can carry several problems and some tags are approximate. Built with Claude (Anthropic), 6 Nov 2026.
